remarks: Affordable Apartment for ages 55+! Please see income requirements. MONTHLY RENT INCLUDES ALL UTILITIES AND PARKING! Electric, gas, water and hot water are included in the monthly rent! Bright, sunny & immaculate PRIVATE, CORNER APARTMENT WITH EXTRA WINDOWS + SUNSHINE! Conveniently located close to downtown Stamford, I-95 and Cove Island Beach. This pretty apartment features: A cheerful, open kitchen, living-dining area, large bedroom with generous closet/storage space and sparkling full bath. There is coin-op laundry on the main level and a pretty patio with tables, lawn & seating area to enjoy the outdoors. On-site management. Many senior services available. Small pets, including dogs, welcome. This property is an income based opportunity with the following provisions: Requirements are as follows:  - Prospective Residents MUST BE 55 Years of Age or Older TO QUALIFY - 1-PERSON HOUSEHOLD income $54,000 minimum - $60,000.00 maximum, 2 PERSON INCOME MAXIMIUM IS $68,550.00 - SENIORS with Housing Subsidies QUALIFY - INTERESTED PARTIES MUST COMPLETE THE ATTACHED APPLICATION IN FULL FOR CONSIDERATION AND IT IS FREE TO APPLY!
